biography.plain_text: Özkan Derindere is a Turkish businessman whose family built its business in vehicle sales and leasing. Born in Samsun, he began working in the family group during his school years and became a partner in 1979. He succeeded his father, Ömer, in leading the business, and chaired fleet-leasing company DRD.

long_biography.plain_text:
Özkan Derindere backed electric vehicles through DMA, a company he established with Önder Yol. The partners funded the project from their own resources, developing cars for sale and lease. DMA produced its own electronic control units and software, while adapting existing cars rather than claiming an entirely new domestic vehicle.

His work with the Derindere Foundation also included university scholarships. During a visit to Hitit University’s vocational school in Osmancık, he discussed assistance for academically successful students who lacked financial means. As foundation chairman, he committed to extending scholarships and related educational support as the foundation’s resources allowed.
